Platform._AdminKey: NEVER commit this. Shared secret the tenant API requires on /api/v1/platform/* calls. Set Platform:AdminKey in appsettings.Local.json (or PLATFORM__ADMINKEY) here AND the same value in the API. The app refuses to start without a real one.
Platform._Comment_AutoSuspend: Nightly sweep that disables organizations whose subscription is past its grace period (only those with AutoSuspend = 1).

Landing._Comment: Origins of the public marketing site, allowed to read /api/landing-content cross-origin. Enforced outside Development only; in Development any localhost port is accepted so a dev server that shifts port does not read as a CORS bug. List the real site's origin before deploying; the endpoint is anonymous, so this must never be a wildcard.
